title: Turn Your Footage into Promo Videos
summary: Use the clips, photos and music you already own to make finished promos and social clips each week, without booking an editor.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you would otherwise pay an editor for short promos; savings come from making them in house.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Steady promo videos for launches, events and offers.
Editing money stays in the business.
who_its_for: Small brands, venues and shops with phone footage.
Musicians and creators who sell their own work.

stack.name: Vidness

steps.name: Vidness

steps: Collect footage, photos and music you own.
Make one promo and pick a style.
Check captions and claims, then post yourself.
guardrails: Use only footage and music you own or have a license for.
